question: Find all products costing less than 1000.
expected_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price < 1000 ORDER BY product_id

question: List all products in the Electronics category.
expected_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics' ORDER BY product_id

question: Find the most expensive product.
expected_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price DESC, product_id LIMIT 1

question: Count all products in the store.
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products

question: Find the average price of all products.
expected_sql: SELECT AVG(price) FROM products

question: Find products with fewer than 30 items in stock.
expected_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE stock < 30 ORDER BY product_id

question: List customers who live in Mumbai.
expected_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE city = 'Mumbai' ORDER BY customer_id

question: Show each order ID with the name of the customer who placed it.
expected_sql: SELECT orders.order_id, customers.name FROM orders JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id ORDER BY orders.order_id

question: Find the total quantity ordered for each product, including products never ordered.
expected_sql: SELECT products.name, COALESCE(SUM(order_items.quantity), 0) FROM products LEFT JOIN order_items ON products.product_id = order_items.product_id GROUP BY products.product_id, products.name ORDER BY products.product_id

question: Find the total value of items in each order.
expected_sql: SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id ORDER BY order_id

question: List products priced between 500 and 2000 inclusive.
expected_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price BETWEEN 500 AND 2000 ORDER BY price, product_id

question: List products that have at least 30 items in stock.
expected_sql: SELECT name, stock FROM products WHERE stock >= 30 ORDER BY product_id

question: Show all products from cheapest to most expensive.
expected_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price, product_id

question: Find the three cheapest products.
expected_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price, product_id LIMIT 3

question: Find the total number of products in each category.
expected_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

question: Find the average product price in each category.
expected_sql: SELECT category, AVG(price) FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

question: Find the highest-priced product in each category.
expected_sql: SELECT category, MAX(price) FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

question: Find categories that contain more than one product.
expected_sql: SELECT category FROM products GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY category

question: List all orders that have been delivered.
expected_sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered' ORDER BY order_id

question: List orders that are not delivered.
expected_sql: SELECT order_id, status FROM orders WHERE status <> 'delivered' ORDER BY order_id

question: Find orders placed on or after 2026-09-05.
expected_sql: SELECT order_id, order_date FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-09-05' ORDER BY order_date, order_id

question: Count the number of orders for each status.
expected_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

question: Find the names of customers who have placed at least one order.
expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT customers.name FROM customers JOIN orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id ORDER BY customers.name

question: Find customers who have never placed an order.
expected_sql: SELECT customers.name FROM customers LEFT JOIN orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id WHERE orders.order_id IS NULL ORDER BY customers.customer_id

question: Show each order date, order ID, and customer name.
expected_sql: SELECT orders.order_date, orders.order_id, customers.name FROM orders JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id ORDER BY orders.order_date, orders.order_id

question: Find all orders placed by customers from Mumbai.
expected_sql: SELECT orders.order_id FROM orders JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id WHERE customers.city = 'Mumbai' ORDER BY orders.order_id

question: Count orders placed by each customer, including customers with no orders.
expected_sql: SELECT customers.name, COUNT(orders.order_id) FROM customers LEFT JOIN orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id GROUP BY customers.customer_id, customers.name ORDER BY customers.customer_id

question: Find the total amount spent on order items by each customer across all their orders.
expected_sql: SELECT customers.name, COALESCE(SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price), 0) FROM customers LEFT JOIN orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id LEFT JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id GROUP BY customers.customer_id, customers.name ORDER BY customers.customer_id

question: List the product names and quantities in order 101.
expected_sql: SELECT products.name, order_items.quantity FROM order_items JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.product_id WHERE order_items.order_id = 101 ORDER BY products.product_id

question: Find the names of products included in delivered orders.
expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT products.name FROM products JOIN order_items ON products.product_id = order_items.product_id JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id WHERE orders.status = 'delivered' ORDER BY products.name

question: Find the total quantity of items in each order.
expected_sql: SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id ORDER BY order_id

question: Find the average quantity per order item.
expected_sql: SELECT AVG(quantity) FROM order_items

question: Find products that have never appeared in any order item.
expected_sql: SELECT products.name FROM products LEFT JOIN order_items ON products.product_id = order_items.product_id WHERE order_items.order_item_id IS NULL ORDER BY products.product_id

question: Find the number of distinct products that have been ordered.
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) FROM order_items

question: Find the total revenue value of all order items, regardless of order status.
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price) FROM order_items

question: Find the total item value for delivered orders only.
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price) FROM order_items JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id WHERE orders.status = 'delivered'

question: Find products whose names contain the word 'Cable'.
expected_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%Cable%' ORDER BY product_id

question: Find products whose category is either Electronics or Accessories.
expected_sql: SELECT name, category FROM products WHERE category IN ('Electronics', 'Accessories') ORDER BY product_id

question: Find products priced above the average price of all products.
expected_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products) ORDER BY price DESC, product_id

question: Find the second most expensive product.
expected_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC, product_id LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

question: Find the customer who placed order 103.
expected_sql: SELECT customers.name FROM orders JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id WHERE orders.order_id = 103

question: Find the city and number of customers in each city.
expected_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY city

question: Find cities with more than one registered customer.
expected_sql: SELECT city FROM customers GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY city

question: Find orders that contain more than one unit in total.
expected_sql: SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING SUM(quantity) > 1 ORDER BY order_id

question: Find each product's name and the total revenue generated by that product, including products with no sales.
expected_sql: SELECT products.name, COALESCE(SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price), 0) FROM products LEFT JOIN order_items ON products.product_id = order_items.product_id GROUP BY products.product_id, products.name ORDER BY products.product_id

question: Find the most recently placed order.
expected_sql: SELECT order_id, order_date FROM orders ORDER BY order_date DESC, order_id DESC LIMIT 1

question: Find all customers whose names start with the letter A.
expected_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE name LIKE 'A%' ORDER BY customer_id

question: Find products with a price exactly equal to 799.
expected_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price = 799 ORDER BY product_id

question: Find orders whose total item value exceeds 1000.
expected_sql: SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING SUM(quantity * unit_price) > 1000 ORDER BY order_id

question: For each category, show the number of products and their average price, sorted by average price from highest to lowest.
expected_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*), AVG(price) FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY AVG(price) DESC, category
